description: An open-source AI coding agent that does not stop at code. Ava reads your codebase, plans the work and executes it task by task — then keeps going: your training and meals, what you want to learn, the assets you need. 7 modes, 120+ tools, 24 specialist personas, and frontier open-weight models from every major lab. Runs on your own machine — memory, history and journal stay there. No account and no card to start; bring your own API key, or take 300 credits a month on a free plan. Apache 2.0, so you can read every line of it.

command.newChat.title: New Chat — Fresh conversation with full context reset
command.clearChat.title: Clear Chat — Remove all messages from the current session

setting.activeModel.description: Select the AI model to use. Three orchestrated routing modes — Maestro (single coordinator), Supernova (polyglot ensemble), Aurora (Mistral-only EU stack) — plus managed Qwen + Mistral and BYOK across DeepSeek V4, Kimi K3, Claude, Mistral, Zhipu, MiniMax, Xiaomi. 300 free credits per month with a free account.
setting.deepseek.apiKey.description: DeepSeek API key — V4 Pro and V4 Flash (MIT-licensed open-weight, 1M context, $0.14/$0.28 to $1.74/$3.48 per M tokens)
setting.kimi.apiKey.description: Kimi (Moonshot AI) API key — K2.7 Code, agentic coding leader, 256K context
setting.qwen.apiKey.description: Qwen (Alibaba Cloud) API key — Qwen 3.7 Plus and 3.7 Max, plus 3.5 Plus and 3.5 Flash, with vision and thinking
setting.temperature.description: Sampling temperature (0 = deterministic, 1 = creative). Default 0.7 balances precision and creativity.
setting.language.description: Language for Ava's UI and responses. Supports 20 languages including Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, French, German, Arabic, Hindi, and more.
setting.permissionMode.description: Controls which of Ava's 120 tools require your approval. Strict = safest (approve writes + shell). Balanced = auto-approve file edits. Autonomous = full agent freedom.
command.gettingStarted.title: Getting Started — Setup wizard for new users
walkthrough.title: Getting Started with Ava
walkthrough.description: Set up your AI coding agent in minutes — or skip setup and use a free model instantly
walkthrough.step.apiKey.title: Add your API key (or use free credits)
walkthrough.step.apiKey.description: Sign up for 300 free credits per month, or bring your own API key from [DeepSeek](https://platform.deepseek.com/api_keys), [Kimi](https://platform.moonshot.ai/console/api-keys), [Qwen](https://bailian.console.alibabacloud.com/), or any supported provider.
walkthrough.step.model.title: Select a model
walkthrough.step.model.description: Choose a model from the [Active Model setting](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%22ava-supernova.activeModel%22). Each model has different strengths — pick what fits your workflow.
walkthrough.step.language.title: Set your language
walkthrough.step.language.description: Ava supports 20 languages. Set your preferred [language](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%22ava-supernova.preferences.language%22) or leave on auto-detect.
walkthrough.step.permissions.title: Choose a permission mode
walkthrough.step.permissions.description: Control what Ava can do without asking. Start with **Strict** (default) and upgrade later. [Open permission settings](command:workbench.action.openSettings?%22ava-supernova.preferences.permissionMode%22).
walkthrough.step.start.title: Start chatting
walkthrough.step.start.description: You're ready! [Open Ava Chat](command:ava-supernova.openChat) and start building.
command.openDocs.title: Documentation — Models, tools, commands, and configuration
command.openDashboard.title: Open Dashboard — Command centre, settings, sync, library, and more
setting.maxTokens.description: Maximum tokens per model response. Higher values allow longer responses but use more API credits.
setting.autoMemory.description: Automatically save important context (project patterns, user preferences, decisions) to structured memory with TF-IDF retrieval, branch scoping, and auto-archival. Credentials are never saved — blocked at runtime.
setting.memoryLocalOnly.description: Keep all memories stored locally only. When enabled, memories will not sync to the Ava platform even with a connected account. Your data stays on your machine.
setting.streamResponses.description: Stream model responses token-by-token as they arrive. Disable for batch mode (waits for full response).
setting.section.modelApi: Model & API — Maestro + managed models + BYOK across 8 providers
setting.help.docs: **[Open Documentation](command:ava-supernova.openDocs)** — Full reference for 120+ tools, the model lineup across 8 providers, 20 languages, permission modes, memory system, and more.
setting.help.gettingStarted: **[Open Getting Started](command:ava-supernova.gettingStarted)** — Step-by-step setup walkthrough. Or just start chatting — free models work instantly.
